series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 7 Consumer Trends To Run With In 2014
notes: First archived 2013-12-05. Labels from the numbered section headings. target_year 2014 from the title. The 2014 Premium Service report is not captured.

entries.label: GUILT-FREE STATUS
entries.quote: Indeed, GUILT-FREE STATUS will be the ultimate indulgence in 2014.
entries.subject: Guilt-free consumption as status
entries.note: Teaser: 'Why in 2014, guilt-free is the new status symbol.'

entries.label: CROWD SHAPED
entries.quote: In 2014, more people will pool their data, their profiles, their preferences, in groups (small and big) to shape new goods and services.
entries.subject: Pooled consumer data shaping products

entries.label: MADE GREENER BY/FOR CHINA
entries.quote: In 2014, perceptions of China will take another significant turn, as consumers come to realize China is fast becoming the epicenter of truly innovative, superior green consumer innovations, too*.
entries.subject: Chinese green consumer innovation
entries.note: The asterisk is in the source (footnote on MADE BETTER IN CHINA).

entries.label: MYCHIATRY
entries.quote: Consumers will increasingly see their smartphones as devices for total lifestyle assistance.
entries.subject: Mental-wellbeing tracking and self-treatment apps
entries.note: Teaser: 'Why in 2014, mind will be the new body.'

entries.label: NO DATA
entries.quote: Why in 2014, delivering brilliant service without excessive data collection will earn you consumer trust (and profits won’t be far behind ;)
entries.subject: Privacy-respecting service with minimal data collection

entries.label: THE INTERNET OF CARING THINGS
entries.quote: Anything exceptional that ‘connected objects’ can do for consumers, whether that’s monitoring or improving health, helping them save money, getting chores done, will be warmly welcomed next year and beyond.
entries.subject: Consumer-centred Internet of Things
entries.note: The section cites Gartner (October 2013): IoT adds USD 1.9 trillion of economic value in 2020; up to 30 billion connected devices in 2020. Gartner's forecasts, not trendwatching's; not recorded as metric.

entries.label: GLOBAL BRAIN
entries.quote: 2014 will see the consumer arena become even more global, local, flatter, cosmopolitan and so on.
entries.subject: Globalized consumer innovation
entries.note: Section mainly announces trendwatching's own free regional Trend Bulletins (Asia, Africa, South & Central America). Same label as 2007 THE GLOBAL BRAIN with a different meaning.
